name: Brand Story Deck
description: An editable, browser-ready 16:9 presentation that turns brand strategy into a polished story using bold, grounded color blocks and an editorial type pairing.
whatYouGet: A self-contained HTML deck with 8–10 slides and editable text.
A coherent narrative from audience need to brand promise and launch action.
A consistent color-block visual system with restrained, purposeful emphasis.
A realistic sample deck to demonstrate the format and pacing.
goodFit: Brand identity and positioning presentations for internal or client review.
Product launch narratives for marketing and cross-functional teams.
notFor: Detailed financial reporting or technical documentation.
Final production artwork, logos, or a complete brand guidelines package.
requiredInputs: Brand or product context and intended audience.
Available positioning, proof points, and launch objectives.

faq.q: Can I edit the deck after it is generated?
faq.a: Yes. The deliverable is a self-contained HTML slide deck with editable text and presentation-friendly 16:9 layouts.

faq.q: What if I do not have final brand guidelines?
faq.a: Provide the context and any known preferences. The deck can use a proposed visual direction and clearly distinguish recommendations from established brand facts.

demoPrompt: /sl-brand-story-deck Create exactly 8 slides for fictional Alder Row, a neighborhood refill shop. Move from waste-reduction friction through the current routine, service idea, three-part promise, refill-station visual, four-step launch, to practical actions. Title: “Alder Row makes refilling fit real life.” Close: “Lead with ease, then prove the routine works.” Use restrained Moss & Signal styling; label assumptions illustrative.
followUpPrompts: Tighten the story for a five-minute leadership presentation without adding claims.
Turn the launch message framework into a concise campaign brief.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
